hero.note: Runs right in your browser — no download, no sign-up.
hero.intro: SpaceDraw is a free draw and guess game online that runs straight in your browser. Sketch the secret word before the timer ends, or race to type the winning guess — no download and no sign-up.

steps.title: Pick an avatar
steps.body: Choose one of 10 original avatars and a display name. Nothing is stored on a server.

steps.title: Get your secret word
steps.body: The drawer is given three word choices from a category and difficulty level.

steps.title: Draw or guess
steps.body: Sketch the word before the timer ends, or type guesses in the chat to earn speed points.

cards.title: Solo practise mode
cards.body: Warm up against simulated challengers without waiting for a lobby to fill.

cards.title: Private rooms with a code
cards.body: Create a room and share its code. Simulated players fill the lobby today; live multiplayer is coming later.

cards.title: Custom round settings
cards.body: Adjust the timer, number of rounds and word difficulty to suit your group.

cards.title: Word packs by difficulty
cards.body: Browse categorised word packs across Easy, Medium and Hard levels.

rooms.body: Set a room code, pick your rules and start drawing. Rooms run with simulated players for now — real-time multiplayer is a future update.

mobile.body: A touch-responsive canvas works smoothly on phones, tablets and desktops, so you can play anywhere without installing an app.

words.note: Demo word packs currently ship in English; localised packs are on the way.

faq.note: Quick answers to the most common questions.

footer.tagline: A free draw-and-guess game that runs in your browser.
footer.languageNote: This page is available in several languages. Search engines serve the version that matches your region.
